_about: The Haunted Swamp (levels 10-20): ghouls, zombies and tormented spirits answer each other across the mire, the will-o-wisps lure, the swamp troll and the great alligators are elites, the swamp hag a sub-boss, and the Bog Witch in her hut fills the ground with bubbling brew and calls up the drowned dead.

helpers.shout: A groan rolls across the mire, and the swamp's dead rise to answer!

90500.name: bog witch
90500.long_desc: The Bog Witch stirs a black cauldron, cackling to herself.
90500.description: Bent, green-skinned and draped in rotting moss, with a necklace of frog skulls and eyes like marsh-lights. The dead of the swamp are her servants, and the will-o-wisps are her lanterns.

phases.message: The Bog Witch shrieks: "Rise, my sleepers!"
